text:
maria: anyone else hitting a weird ordering/race where OkHttp/Retrofit callbacks fire after we call cancel()? seeing onResponse/onFailure run even though call.isCanceled() is true. repro on Pixel 8 emulator Android 14.
kevin: hmm interesting — is this the okhttp 4.11 branch or 4.10? sample app?
sam: quick question: are you using enqueue() or coroutines suspend wrapper?
maria: enqueue(). minimal repro: attach a cancel on a button that calls call.cancel() immediately after enqueue. sometimes onResponse runs, sometimes onFailure with SocketTimeout, and occasionally both. logs: 
```
I/SDK: enqueue started
I/SDK: cancel invoked
I/SDK: onResponse - 200 OK
I/SDK: onFailure - java.net.SocketTimeoutException: timeout
```
kevin: can you paste dependencies + OkHttp config? retryOnConnectionFailure? dispatcher size?
maria: deps: retrofit 2.9.0, okhttp 4.11.0, kotlin coroutines 1.7.3. OkHttp: new OkHttpClient.Builder().retryOnConnectionFailure(true).build()
lukas: two things to try: 1) set retryOnConnectionFailure(false) — retries can surface later callbacks. 2) check your executor: OkHttp uses Dispatcher with limited threads; if main thread blocks you may see weird ordering.
sam: also make sure your onResponse checks call.isCanceled() at top and bail. I've seen enqueue still deliver when the network path finished right as cancel came in.
maria: good point — added check and it helps. curious if there's a deeper bug: cancel() should prevent any successful onResponse delivery, right?
kevin: cancel() prevents streaming of response body but if response already laid out and queued on the callback executor, you might still get a callback. Not a great UX though.
lukas: for coroutines we wrap like: 
```
suspendCancellableCoroutine { cont ->
  val call = service.getFoo().call
  cont.invokeOnCancellation { call.cancel() }
  call.enqueue(object: Callback { ... })
}
```
and inside onResponse check cont.isActive?
maria: repro gist: https://paste.example/repro - sample app attached. can someone try on Android 13 too?
build-bot: CI run started for repro-app #423 — emulator matrix: API 30, 33, 34
kevin: thanks — if CI reproduces we should open a small eng-runtime ticket. also doc note for SDK: recommend checking call.isCanceled() in callback and prefer coroutines wrapper that cancels underlying call on coroutine cancel.
sam: tiny workaround: set client.dispatcher().executorService().shutdown() during test to flush? risky.
maria: ok thanks all — I'll try retryOnConnectionFailure=false and add isCanceled guard, push update to repro. will update thread with CI results :thumbsup:
